title: 2 wounded in roadside shooting in Laoag

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— Two men were wounded after unidentified men shot them while they were riding an e-bike along Buttong-Darayday Road in Barangay Buttong in Laoag City in nearby Ilocos Norte on Wednesday (Oct. 7), police said. An initial report disclosed that the victims, both of legal age, are residents of Barangay Bengcag, also in Laoag. Police said the suspects were two men riding a motorcycle who opened fire on the victims as both vehicles were traveling south.
